events.title: Arab Film Festival: Chronicle of a Disappearance at the Roxie
events.why: A one-night Arab Film Festival screening of Elia Suleiman's classic, an advance-ticket option for parents after the kids' daytime events.

events.title: California State Parks Free Day-Use for Veterans and Active Duty
events.venue: Mount Tamalpais State Park and 144 other state parks
events.why: Veterans, active-duty, and reserve members with ID get free day-use at 145 state parks for the holiday, a reason to add a Mount Tam hike to a Marin day.

events.title: Crab Cove Veterans Day Remembrance
events.venue: Doug Siden Visitor Center, Crab Cove, 1252 McKay Ave
events.why: A free East Bay Regional Parks afternoon with a self-guided history walk about Alameda's wartime past, flag-folding demonstrations, and crafts; easy to pair with the USS Hornet a few minutes away.

events.title: Cupertino Veterans Day Ceremony
events.why: The city-sponsored ceremony at the Cupertino Veterans Memorial runs 11:00 to 13:00 and is the nearest formal observance to Menlo Park on the Peninsula side.

events.title: Danville Veterans Day Open House and Museum Exhibition with Huey Helicopter and Beacon Lighting
events.venue: Veterans Memorial Building of San Ramon Valley, 400 Hartz Ave
events.why: All-day free open house with a Huey helicopter and F-8 jet cockpit outdoors, an 11 a.m. family-friendly ceremony, and a sunset Mount Diablo beacon lighting.

events.title: Danville Veterans Day Open House, Museum Exhibition and Beacon Lighting
events.venue: Veterans Memorial Building of San Ramon Valley, 400 Hartz Ave
events.why: An all-day free event with Revolutionary War to Spanish-American War artifacts, a Huey helicopter and military vehicles outside, Quest Science Center family activities, an 11:00 observance with the Monte Vista High School choir, and the Mount Diablo beacon lighting at 16:40.

events.title: East Bay Regional Parks Free Entry and Parking for Veterans
events.venue: Ardenwood Historic Farm and other East Bay Regional Parks
events.why: The park district waives entry and parking for veterans, service members, and retirees on Veterans Day across its parks, including Ardenwood Historic Farm.

events.title: East Bay Regional Parks Veterans Day Free Entry (Ardenwood Historic Farm)
events.why: The park district waives entry and parking fees for veterans and active service members at fee parks including Ardenwood; regular admission applies to other family members.

events.title: Fairfield Veterans Day Celebration and Parade: Honoring All Who Served
events.why: Solano County's big annual Veterans Day with a 10 a.m. ceremony and concert followed by a 12:30 p.m. parade down Kentucky Street.

events.title: Fairfield Veterans Day Celebration: Honoring All Who Served
events.why: Fairfield, home to Travis Air Force Base, holds its free annual celebration in the downtown theater; only worth it if you are already heading north.

events.title: Free National Parks Day at Muir Woods
events.why: Entrance fees are waived at all national parks for Veterans Day, including Muir Woods, though a paid parking or shuttle reservation is still required.

events.title: Free National Parks Day: Muir Woods and Hyde Street Pier
events.why: Veterans Day is a fee-free day at national parks, so the $15 Muir Woods entrance fee is waived, but parking reservations ($10) are still required and free entry now applies only to US citizens and permanent residents.

events.title: Handel's The Power of Music: Philharmonia Baroque at Bing Concert Hall
events.why: A US premiere of the 1742 Dublin version of Handel's Alexander's Feast by Philharmonia Baroque, a ticketed holiday-evening concert ten minutes from home.

events.title: Los Altos Veterans Day Ceremony at Veterans Community Plaza
events.venue: Veterans Community Plaza, State St and Main St
events.why: An afternoon ceremony in downtown Los Altos fifteen minutes from Menlo Park, so it can follow a morning event elsewhere.

events.title: Los Altos Veterans Day Observance
events.venue: Veterans Community Plaza, State and Main streets
events.why: An afternoon downtown ceremony close to home, with the Cradle of Liberty statue at Shoup Park Veterans Memorial a short walk away.

events.title: Marin County Veterans Day Ceremony
events.venue: Exhibit Hall, Marin Veterans' Memorial Auditorium, 20 Avenue of the Flags
events.why: Marin's county-wide ceremony is early enough to combine with the Sausalito schooner sail or a Muir Woods visit the same day.

events.title: Marin Veterans Day Ceremony
events.venue: Marin Veterans' Memorial Auditorium, 10 Avenue of the Flags
events.why: Marin County's main free morning ceremony, which fits before a Muir Woods free-entry visit or the Sausalito schooner sail.

events.title: Martinez Veterans Day Ceremony at Alhambra Pioneer Cemetery
events.venue: Alhambra Pioneer Cemetery, 3 Carquinez Scenic Dr
events.why: A historic-cemetery ceremony followed by a community gathering at Plaza Ignacio Park, a different setting from the parade-style events.

events.title: Milpitas Veterans Day Ceremony
events.why: A short morning civic ceremony that fits before the San Jose parade a few miles south.

events.title: Milpitas Veterans Day Ceremony with Community Concert Band
events.why: A short formal ceremony with the Milpitas Community Concert Band playing patriotic music and the Veteran of the Year announcement, timed to finish before the San Jose parade.

events.title: Mountain View Veterans Day Ceremony at Eagle Park
events.why: A one-hour American Legion ceremony timed to the Armistice hour, fifteen minutes from Menlo Park and over by noon.

events.title: Petaluma Veterans Day Parade & Huey Flyover: Celebrating 250 Years
events.why: The North Bay's biggest parade pairs a downtown procession with a Vietnam-era Huey helicopter flyover and landing plus other flyovers, which kids this age tend to remember; worth the roughly 90-minute drive.

events.title: Petaluma Veterans Day Parade and Huey Helicopter Flyover
events.why: The biggest Veterans Day parade north of the Golden Gate, with 200-plus entries, a USAF jazz combo at noon, a 1 p.m. parade, and a Huey Vets helicopter flyover kids will remember.

events.title: Pinole Veterans Day Celebration and Flag Retirement Ceremony
events.why: Pinole's second annual celebration features a flag retirement ceremony, speeches, and entertainment, a rarely seen ritual that is educational for kids.

events.title: Presidio Veterans Day Interfaith Service
events.why: The annual service in the historic Presidio chapel starts at the 11th hour of the 11th day; free but reservations are requested by email to presidiointerfaith@gmail.com.

events.title: Rohnert Park Veterans Day Celebration
events.venue: Rohnert Park Community Center, 5401 Snyder Lane
events.why: A Sonoma County community celebration that pairs with the Petaluma parade and flyover fifteen minutes down the road.

events.title: San Jose Veterans Day Parade (108th, largest in Northern California)
events.why: Held since 1918, this is the largest Veterans Day parade in Northern California and falls on a school holiday.

events.title: San Jose Veterans Day Parade: A Salute to Our Vietnam Veterans
events.venue: Plaza de Cesar Chavez / Market Street, downtown
events.why: The largest Veterans Day parade in Northern California, running since 1918, with an 11:00 ceremony at Plaza de Cesar Chavez before the parade steps off down Market Street; the closest big holiday tradition to Menlo Park.

events.title: Stanford Memorial Auditorium Veterans Day Open House
events.why: The auditorium lobby opens 11:00 to 17:00 so visitors can see the memorial plaques for Stanford's war dead and the wreaths in Memorial Court; a free ten-minute outing from Menlo Park.

events.title: Stanford Veterans Day Wreaths at Memorial Court and Memorial Auditorium
events.venue: Memorial Court and Memorial Auditorium, Stanford University
events.why: Stanford places wreaths and displays the president's letter at its war memorials, with plaques viewable 11 a.m. to 5 p.m., a quiet ten-minute-away stop for a family walk.

events.title: Veterans Day Choral Evensong at St Thomas Anglican
events.venue: St Thomas Anglican Church, Pacific Heights
events.why: A free hour of Remembrance Day choral music to close the holiday for a family already in the city that evening.

events.title: Veterans Day Cruise Aboard the USS Potomac
events.venue: USS Potomac, Jack London Square, 540 Water St
events.why: A once-a-year bay cruise on FDR's presidential yacht that pauses at the USS Hornet for a bagpipe-and-choir ceremony before a box-lunch sail, so advance tickets are needed.

events.title: Veterans Day Cruise on FDR's Yacht USS Potomac
events.why: A ticketed three-hour Bay cruise on the presidential yacht with a bagpiper, the Oakland Interfaith Youth Choir, a tribute ceremony alongside the USS Hornet, and a box lunch; limited seats, book ahead.

events.title: Veterans Day Interfaith Service at the Presidio Chapel
events.why: A free, all-ages one-hour service in the historic Presidio chapel with keynote speaker Michael Blecker of Swords to Plowshares; advance RSVP by email requested.

events.title: Veterans Day Sail on Schooner Seaward
events.why: Call of the Sea's tall-ship sail on the Bay with check-in at 12:45; every passenger needs an advance ticket and these sails sell out.

events.title: Veterans Day Sail on the Schooner Seaward
events.why: Call of the Sea's annual three-hour tall-ship sail on the bay with check-in at 12:45 p.m., bring-your-own food, and free parking, a ticketed one-day event that sells out.

events.title: Veterans Day aboard the USS Hornet
events.venue: USS Hornet Sea, Air and Space Museum, 707 W Hornet Ave
events.why: A ceremony with guest speakers on the deck of a real aircraft carrier, plus full access to the ship on a day off school.

events.title: Walnut Creek Veterans Day Ceremony and Concert
events.venue: Lesher Center for the Arts, 1601 Civic Dr
events.why: A free one-hour indoor ceremony with live music in a proper theater, a good option if the weather turns.

events.title: Zoppe Italian Family Circus: Special Veterans Day Matinees
events.why: The one-ring European family circus adds special Wednesday shows at noon and 4 p.m. for the holiday, ten minutes from Menlo Park with every seat within 20 feet of the ring.

events.title: Arab Film Festival Outdoor Movie Night: Spices and Lies
events.why: Free outdoor screening of a French-Algerian food rom-com with shawarma and kunafa vendors, marking the festival's 30th anniversary; RSVP required.

events.title: Menlo Park Storytelling Festival: StoryFest Online
events.why: The hometown library's annual storytelling festival streams a lineup of live tellers for all ages, a free weeknight option without leaving the house.

events.title: Bhangra & Beats Diwali Night Market
events.why: The City's official Diwali night market, billed as a family-friendly Indian rave with DJs, dance and street food, free and all ages.

events.title: Cubberley Artist Studio Program Open Studios
events.why: Twenty-three resident artists open their studios with an AR asteroid sculpture, a FOPAL book sale and an Oaxacan food truck, ten minutes from Menlo Park.

events.title: Friends of the Menlo Park Library Autumn Book Sale
events.why: Twice-a-year sale of thousands of books, kids' titles and DVDs mostly priced $1 to $2, right in town; also Friday Nov 13, 14:00 to 17:00.

events.title: Gamble Garden Second Saturday: Seeds and Indigenous Heritage Month
events.why: Free hands-on garden morning making seed bracelets and seed bombs and exploring acorn traditions, with a plant sale; timed-entry registration.

events.title: Holidays at Filoli Opening Day
events.why: First day of Filoli's holiday season, with a new Family Farm of mini cows and goats in the redwoods, 200+ decorated trees and a Celtic-themed house, 15 minutes from Menlo Park.

events.title: Kuchipudi Dance with Manaswini Avvari
events.why: Free one-hour classical Indian dance performance at the local community college, a short cultural outing close to home.

events.title: Peninsula Youth Theatre: The Wizard of Oz
events.venue: Mountain View Center for the Performing Arts, Main Stage
events.why: Opening weekend of the local youth theatre's full-scale Wizard of Oz, with performers the same age as your kids; also 19:30 Saturday and 13:00 Sunday.

events.title: Renegade Craft Holiday Fair
events.why: 250+ curated makers plus food trucks in one indoor hall, a strong early holiday-shopping outing; also Sunday Nov 15, $5 suggested donation.

events.title: Rhône By The Bay Wine Tasting
events.why: ADULTS ONLY (21+): 44 Rhône Rangers wineries pour about 150 American Grenache, Syrah and Viognier bottlings in a walk-around tasting.

events.title: Rock the Dock Concert Series: Pop Rocks
events.venue: Port of Redwood City, 459 Seaport Court
events.why: Final free waterfront concert of the season at the Port, with food vendors and room for kids to roam; county listing says 14:30, port site lists series slots at 15:30, so confirm start time.

events.title: SF Tea Festival at the Ferry Building
events.why: Taste hundreds of teas from 30+ vendors with a souvenir porcelain cup included; also Sunday Nov 15 and $5 off with code FUNCHEAP.

events.title: SF VegFest 2026
events.why: 27th annual plant-based food festival with 80+ exhibitors, chef demos and comedians, a good grazing day for curious eaters.

events.title: The Big Open: 100+ Sausalito Artists Open Studios
events.why: Once-a-year weekend when 100+ working artists open their waterfront studios; also runs Sunday Nov 15.

events.title: Feathered Friends: Birdwatching & Nature Art for Families
events.venue: San Francisco Botanical Garden, Main Gate
events.why: Early-morning guided birdwatching on fall migration plus a nature-art session; $40 covers one adult and one child ages 5 to 12, so suits the 9-year-old.

events.title: Neave Trio at Kohl Mansion
events.why: Adult-oriented: acclaimed piano trio in the Great Hall of a 1914 Tudor mansion, with a free pre-concert talk at 18:00 and $30 tickets for under-30s.

events.title: Palo Alto Youth Council Mental Health Fair for Parents & Teens
events.venue: Mitchell Park Community Center, 3700 Middlefield Rd
events.why: Teen-run fair with youth mental health experts, therapy dogs and free refreshments, designed for parents to attend with their teens.

events.title: Shadelands FallFest
events.why: Free try-it sports sampler for kids with food trucks, shelter animals and a pink fire engine, good for active 9-to-14-year-olds.

events.title: Menlo Park Storytelling Festival: Jeff Gere, True Supernatural Tales of Hawaii
events.why: Touring Hawaiian storyteller performs spooky true tales at the hometown library as part of the free annual festival; check the library calendar for the start time.

events.title: Embarcadero Center Holiday Market & 40th Annual Building Lighting
events.why: The once-a-year moment when all four Embarcadero towers light up for the holidays, paired with a holiday market, kicking off the season downtown.
